verdict.rationale: Granola ships its own REST API, with a published OpenAPI 3.1 spec and /v1 endpoints for notes, transcripts, folders, spaces, audit, webhook-endpoints and legal holds, plus an MCP server for querying notes. The documented surface is mostly read access to notes and data, though, and nothing shows parity with the UI. Many UI capabilities have no documented API equivalent, and the API is gated to Business/Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: API equivalents for Chat, recipes, templates, recording and note creation, follow-up email drafting, link sharing and note deletion/restore, settings such as retention and model-training opt-out, any parity claim, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Granola API lets you build custom integrations with programmatic access to meeting notes, transcripts, and AI summaries.
/v1 endpoints for notes, transcripts, folders, spaces, audit, webhook-endpoints, and legal holds
When you create an API key, you choose which note access scopes it should include.
